name: Projected Distinguishing Range / Combinatorial Eluder Dimension
details: The exact universal inequality $\mathrm R^p\ge\mathrm{Edim}$ is false. This finite strict counterexample does not refute an affine comparison.
proof: The database-owned values on $\mathcal D_{\mathrm{RE}}=\{000,001,011,110\}$ are $\mathrm R^p=2$ and $\mathrm{Edim}=3$. Their full proofs are the corresponding value records and generated survey value proofs.
